name: Natsuyasumi ni Sensein Chide
original_name: なつやすみにセンセーんちで
source:
It's summer vacation, and Mai goes to her teacher's house to get some help with her homework.
But her mind seems to be set on something else...
Become Mai's teacher, and spend a hot summer day with her!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ037323.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
暑假到了，麦去老师家寻求作业辅导。
但她的心思似乎在别的事情上……
成为麦的老师，和她一起度过炎热的夏日！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ037323.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
